newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 2.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 2.

text.p: These are the headlines of Radio Latvia news reported on Friday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- According to preliminary data Britain's Labour Party will have a majority 183 votes in the new Parliament.
- U.S. and Russia in Moscow continue co-ordinating their views on NATO enlargement ahead of the planned signing of a co-operation agreement between Russia and the aliance in May.
- Russia will aim its missiles at Baltics if the three countries would join NATO, Viktor Iliyhin, head of Russian Duma's Security Committee told a Rusian language newspaper Panorama Latvii.
- A German police liason officer in Baltics starts his work in the Riga office today.
- Interpol Baltic bureau chiefs meet in Tallinn today to dicuss on-going projects and more efficient exchange of information.
